meta.title: Ambient Gallery (dsh-ambient-gallery)
meta.description: A string of photographs hung behind the main panel — each a different size at its own angle, all with room to breathe, kept to the middle 20-80% of the width. Twenty real landscape photographs ship with the plugin and are pinned onto the wall on first run; every frame rotates up to twenty images, each can be cut into a circle, square, triangle, diamond or hexagon, and the whole wall can switch to one of three code-drawn scenes — karaoke lights, a cockpit HUD, or Earth from orbit — each keeping a small rectangular screen free for a local video.
